confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from search snippets (not full page reads) of Numbeo's Melbourne page (Nov 2026, crowd-sourced) and several 2026 Melbourne cafe and cocktail price guides, so they are ballpark figures. Beer is near Numbeo's 0.5 L draught figure, trimmed toward a standard serve, and the two-person meal is Numbeo's three-course figure nudged up slightly; both are judgment calls. No per-glass wine search was run, so the wine glass uses a local price relationship to the beer anchor (set somewhat above it), checked against Numbeo's mid-range bottle price. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or listings were checked, so they are the least certain. FX is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation seen in search snippets of the RBA Exchange Rates page, not a live page read; the 19 Nov figure was not yet visible. Most price snapshots are Oct-Nov 2026, later than the July 2026 window.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used. Food and drink anchors rest on Melbourne-specific aggregated figures; accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Melbourne's hostel and hotel tiers.
